description: Tram tracks is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. This dataset is a shapefile that contains all of the tram tracks within the city of Melbourne, this data set is generally used for City of Melbourne related queries, therefor we do not hold the entire tram network. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are ptv, public-transport, routes, trams. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, kml, shp. The portal shows 2024-06-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
